short.q: State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words.
short.answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

short.q: Explain the message of the last verse of Surah Al-Kafirun.
short.answer: "For you is your religion and for me is mine." A Muslim stays firm in his faith and respects the right of others to hold their beliefs.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for firmness, 1 mark for respect.

short.q: Describe how the Prophet (S.A.W.) solved the dispute over placing the Black Stone.
short.answer: He placed the stone on a cloak and asked a leader from each tribe to hold an edge and lift it together, then he set it in place.
short.working: 1 mark for the cloak, 1 mark for leaders lifting together, 1 mark for setting it in place.

short.q: In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why.
short.answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
short.working: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

short.q: Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste.
short.answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
short.working: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

short.q: State three times when the siwak or toothbrush is recommended.
short.answer: Before wudhu and prayer, on waking up, when the mouth smells, before sleeping.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct time.

short.q: Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus.
short.answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
short.working: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

short.q: Why is betting in a game not allowed?
short.answer: Gambling is forbidden in Islam because it takes people's wealth unfairly and can cause harm and hatred.
short.working: 1 mark for forbidden, 1 mark for unfairness, 1 mark for harm.

short.q: Explain why we should behave well even when nobody is watching.
short.answer: Allah is Al-Basir and sees everything, and As-Sami' hears everything.
short.working: 1 mark for Allah sees and hears and 1 mark for good behaviour.

short.q: What are angels created from, and what do they never do?
short.answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
short.working: 1 mark for each part.

short.q: Explain why Muslims do not worship angels.
short.answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
short.working: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

short.q: Name the first and the last prophet.
short.answer: Adam was the first and Muhammad (S.A.W.) was the last.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf.
short.answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
short.working: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.

short.q: Name the three types of najasaat.
short.answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health.
short.answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

short.q: State three things that do not nullify wudhu.
short.answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: State four conditions of swalah.
short.answer: Islam and sanity; purity; covering the awrah; facing the Qibla; the time has come.
short.working: 1 mark for each condition.

short.q: Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah.
short.answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
short.working: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

short.q: Name the seven parts of the body that touch the ground in sujud.
short.answer: Forehead with nose, two palms, two knees and toes of both feet.
short.working: 1 mark for forehead, 1 mark for palms and knees, 1 mark for toes.

short.q: State two creatures of Allah in your environment.
short.answer: Any two, for example a cow and a bird.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat?
short.answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
short.working: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

short.q: Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya.
short.answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Give three positive uses of media.
short.answer: Learning, listening to Qur'an and lessons, keeping in touch with family, news, safe skills.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Explain what integrity means when using a phone.
short.answer: Doing the right thing even when nobody sees, because Allah sees and angels record. For example not cheating or copying.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for Allah sees, 1 mark for example.

short.q: How should a Muslim treat a person who asks for help?
short.answer: With kindness and respect, without driving him away, help if in real need, give quietly, or make a kind reply and dua.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point.

short.q: Explain tawakkul using an example.
short.answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

short.q: State four obligations of parents to their children.
short.answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong.
short.answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid point.

short.q: Explain the hadith in which the mother is mentioned three times before the father.
short.answer: The mother deserves the best company because of her great hardship in carrying and raising the child. But the father must also be honoured.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for honouring both.

short.q: Give the meanings of shangazi, mjomba and binamu.
short.answer: Shangazi: father's sister; mjomba: mother's brother; binamu: cousin.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away.
short.answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)?
short.answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation?
short.answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
short.working: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

short.q: Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq?
short.answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
short.working: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.

short.q: What was the Prophet's reply to the angel of the mountains?
short.answer: He refused to let the people be destroyed and hoped Allah would bring from their descendants people who worship Allah alone.
short.working: 1 mark for refusal, 1 mark for hope, 1 mark for descendants.
